notes.title: One year anniversary and upcoming update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I can't believe how fast time passed while I've been busy working on the updates.
TCG Card Shop Simulator has officially been on Steam Early Access for one whole year!

I want to take a quick moment to say a huge THANK YOU to everyone for your support and being part of my solo dev journey. Your feedback, bug reports, and encouragement have really helped me make the game into something far more polished than it was a year ago!

A quick look back at just how far we’ve come together:

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/506517a539d4ca316bf8cfb27725df30c4a7e4be.jpg
The journey has been long, but it’s far from over. The biggest feature still on the roadmap is the playable card game. It may be the final boss on the roadmap, but I’ve been actively playtesting with physical prototypes, exploring mechanics, and refining the design. It’s not quite ready yet, and will probably take quite a while until it's up to standard, but I’m just as excited as you are to see it added to the game!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/5aa09d4e8abdb47bf79eeabe9629771ee78fdfc1.jpg
Next week, there will be an update that comes with some QoL improvements, Steam achievements, bug fixes and a little surprise. Stay tuned!

Again, thank you for being part of this journey. Your support means the world to me, and I’m excited for what’s still to come!

notes.title: Upcoming Update - Card Grading
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081570/42b393b3f458b06d9690d7a28fbc8cec5af34edc.jpg"]

Hey everyone, it's been quite a while since the last update on TCG Card Shop Simulator. I apologize for the silence and I understand the frustration of not seeing any news on Steam. I want to be clear here and say that I will only make official announcements on Steam when I feel fully confident and ready on new update. That said, rest assured I'm still working solely on this game. 

The next update will focus on card grading. It's taking longer than expected as there's just a lot of things to adjust and I want to avoid breaking existing features. However, most of the important functions are already in place. I plan to get the update done and tested by end of August, or latest by early September.


✅ Completed:
Graded card case

Card textures to show imperfections

Graded card pricing

Album just for storing graded cards
🔧 Still in progress:
Sending cards to be graded

Grading card website/app

Price graph for graded cards

Thank you for your patience and continued support!

notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/262ec0efd9496b1bd35668bc5ed69ad113d473af.jpg
Hey everyone, the next update will be shop decoration, and I'm working hard alongside other 3D artists to get it finished. This feature is taking quite some time as there really are a lot of decoration assets to create, but rest assured, it will be coming very soon—most likely by the end of March or, at the latest, early April.

In this upcoming update, you'll be able to customize your shop with new floor, wall, and ceiling textures, as well as decorate your shop with items like posters and more. Can't wait to get this update done and see what kind of card shop you will be creating :)
